lastText: OHLLAGEBERICHTHome19141915191619171918+1MANPOWER-3MUNITIONS-6HOME FRONTXI.1918The Country Goes FirstThe front is still a front. The armies are on ground they hold and the enemy has not walked through them. What has stopped is behind it. Four winters of the blockade, a food supply that has been arithmetic rather than diet for two years, and a political authority that this headquarters spent and then needed. There is no order that reaches this and no reserve that can be moved to it.Contested judgmentThe army did not break in the field. It was never going to be able to hold a front for a country that had stopped being able to supply one.Return to file
